Flexibility & Reliability

Two grades per stylist over the range you pick. Flexibility: do they take their share of the hard shifts — Friday closings, Saturdays, Sundays? Reliability: do they show up for the shifts they're assigned? Click any row to see the details.

Two separate grades, over whatever range you pick

Everyone gets a letter A–F with a 0–100 score underneath. They measure two different things — someone can be great at one and poor at the other.

Flexibility — do they carry their share of the hard shifts?

  • Hard shifts are the ones people tend to avoid: Saturdays, Sundays, and closing shifts. Friday closings and all weekend shifts count the heaviest; weekday closings count some; regular opens/mids are the easy baseline.
  • The grade blends two things, equally: (1) carrying your share of the hard shifts vs. your salon’s rate, and (2) variety — working a real mix of shift types and different days. Both matter, so someone who works only weekends isn’t “flexible” even though those are hard shifts — no range pulls the grade down.
  • Credit follows the person — if they float to another salon to cover a hard shift, it counts for them.
  • Only real floor shifts they worked count. Training, meetings, and no-shows don’t.

Reliability — do they show up for what they’re assigned?

  • Starts at 100 and comes down for problems.
  • No-shows hit hardest. But it’s only a no-show if they worked nowhere that day — if they worked another salon, it’s not counted against them. If a teammate covered their miss, it’s a lighter hit.
  • Lateness is measured by total minutes late, spread across all their shifts — so how late and how often both matter. Being 5 minutes late once is nothing; being 5 minutes late every shift adds up and pulls the grade down. If they were “late” but actually worked a whole different/later shift (a swap), it doesn’t count as lateness.
  • Early-outs count much less — people are often sent home when it’s slow, which isn’t their fault.
  • Covering an unscheduled shift (stepping up) gives a small boost.

The two dig-ins & the salon view

  • Click any person to see their shift-type × day-of-week grid (who camps on easy days vs. spreads out) and their reliability breakdown. Hover any number to see the exact dates and times.
  • Salon Summary ranks salons and flags whether the hard shifts are spread evenly or piled on a couple of people. Watch list surfaces who to talk to.

All of this is measured over the date range you pick at the top, so a call-out in a light week weighs far more than one spread across months.
